note: Little Thunder campground of Lake McConaughy SRA, on the south side of the lake beside Little Thunder Bay: a paved loop of electric plus and full hookup back-ins among trees, on the grass bench above the bay. Beach camping on the sand below is separate and booked 30 days ahead. Alcohol is prohibited. --Claude
